newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic heart device gets FDA approval.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic heart device gets FDA approval.

text.p: Medtronic Inc said on Sunday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration gave marketing approval for Medtronic's Micro Jewel II device, which treats hearts that beat dangerously fast.
The device is the smallest and lightest implantable cardioverter-defribillator, Medtronic said.
The Micro Jewel II is approximately the size of a small pager and weighs 97 grams (about 3-1/2 ounces), Medtronic said.
Medtronic said that shipments would begin in the next few days.
